edges.reason: onlyOperator compares msg.sender with _operator to gate privileged functions.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, which feeds owner and operator checks.
checkEpoch uses now (block.timestamp) compared against nextEpochPoint() to allow execution.
checkStartTime uses now (block.timestamp) to gate execution start.
currentBlockTimestamp derives blockTimestamp directly from block.timestamp.
bondOracle.update is guarded by the checkEpoch timestamp modifier.
The stored pair address is passed to the oracle library to read cumulative prices.
The constructor stores the computed Uniswap pair into the pair state variable.
currentCumulativePrices performs external calls to the untrusted Uniswap pair contract.
The externally called pair contract could execute code that re-enters the oracle during update.
The returned blockTimestamp is subtracted from blockTimestampLast.
The stored blockTimestampLast state variable is the subtrahend of the unchecked delta.
timeElapsed is produced by an unchecked subtraction of timestamps where overflow is intended.
update divides the cumulative price delta by timeElapsed to obtain the average.
timeElapsed is the divisor; zero is handled by an early return instead of a revert.
update computes unchecked differences of cumulative prices from the pair.
price0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the freshly read cumulative value.
price1CumulativeLast is subtracted from the freshly read cumulative value.
The freshly read price0Cumulative local feeds the unchecked subtraction.
The freshly read price1Cumulative local feeds the unchecked subtraction.
The unchecked subtraction result (after division) is written to price0Average.
The unchecked subtraction result (after division) is written to price1Average.
currentCumulativePrices multiplies the fixed point price fraction by timeElapsed with overflow intended.
amountIn is consulted against the stored average price to compute the output.
token selects which stored average price is used in consult.
price0Average is multiplied by amountIn when token equals token0.
price1Average is multiplied by amountIn when token equals token1.
consult returns amountOut computed from the selected average price.
newOperator_ replaces the privileged operator address.
newOwner replaces the contract owner address.

_owner is checked and updated inside transferOwnership.
tokenB is forwarded to the pairFor address derivation.

period is multiplied by epoch in nextEpochPoint.
startTime is added to the epoch offset in nextEpochPoint.
the epoch counter is used in the nextEpochPoint computation.
checkEpoch compares now against nextEpochPoint() before allowing execution.
setPeriod writes the epoch period state variable.

The library returns the extrapolated price1Cumulative to update.

Constructor stores token1 read from the pair.

update writes the new price1CumulativeLast after computing averages.

normalization_plan.reason: amountIn is only consumed to produce the consult return value.
token selection only branches inside consult between the two stored averages.
factory is passed straight through to the library pair address derivation.
tokenA is only forwarded to UniswapV2Library.pairFor for sorting and hashing.
tokenB is only forwarded to UniswapV2Library.pairFor for sorting and hashing.
newOperator_ is validated and written to the _operator state variable.
newOwner is validated and written to the _owner state variable.
amountOut is the computed return value of consult.
price0Cumulative is the library's extrapolated return value feeding update.
price1Cumulative is the library's extrapolated return value feeding update.
blockTimestamp is derived from block.timestamp and returned by the library.
timeElapsed is the divisor used when computing the new averages in update.
timeElapsed is the multiplier for the counterfactual cumulative price extrapolation.
